notes.title: MAINFRAMES - Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings!✨

It’s now been two months since [i]MainFrames[/i] is officially in your hands! 💾

First and foremost, we want to thank everyone who has been playing our game!
Today, we’re back with an update in order to provide you with the smoothest cyber-adventure by fixing some issues: 

[h3]Patch Notes - MainFrames [1.1.0][/h3]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Adelie’s Hints[/b][/u]: Some players had some trouble spotting the secret shortcuts to get around the game’s difficulty spikes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/2438f904383396cd9c216eb28ab42f62b7823394.png[/img]
So, we asked Adelie to appear after a certain number of Floppy’s attempts to give a hint when there’s a secret shortcut in the room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/b0fc1a442f1705f85233158562234308d40547bc.png[/img]
[*] [u][b]Levels Selection[/b][/u]: You can now load any level you’ve already visited at any given point during the game from the pause menu and see its completion percentage.
[*] [u][b]Floppy <[/b][/u]: We made some staging adjustments to ensure that everyone can understand the game’s story without any issues.
[*] [u][b]db Theo[/b][/u]: Some of you were quite disappointed not to know the names of certain characters, so we’ve added them at the beginning of each dialogue.
[*] [u][b]More explosions[/b][/u]: We added more explosions in order to have more explosions.
[*] [u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]: After a well-deserved rest and coffee break, the mini-daemons are now 100% operational and appear after each failed attempt instead of napping.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/87d0c6d0b85c59cc634c07ff5e87c8fe8dd50a96.png[/img]
[/list]
This update is very important to us because it aligns much more with our vision of the game, the one we wish we had delivered at launch. We thank you for your patience and hope you’ll get the chance to enjoy the hard work of all the daemons and process who gave their all to make sure you have a great time! 💗

<,
Theo

notes.title: MainFrames (PC) Review
notes.notes:
Outside of its standout aesthetics, MainFrames is a novel pixelated take on precision platforming and a love letter to both platforming and retro PC enthusiasts.

In MainFrames, you take on the role of Floppy, a cutesy and very pixilated floppy-disc-inspired character. The game opens with Floppy venturing outside the confines of his cozy computerized quarters only to discover that his Personal Computer world or MainFrame (presumably) is in disarray with missing daemons or computer programs strewn about the game world, tasking the player to explore and repair its world.

MainFrames is split into seven distinct zones or levels, all connected by one main hub area, featuring various NPC characters that gradually add exposition throughout the roughly 3-hour playtime of the game. notes.title: MainFrames is a nostalgic PC platformer where you're just a little byte
notes.notes: Perhaps I'd be more inclined to troubleshoot my PC's woes if it signaled distress through adorable window-to-window platforming and chiptunes instead of blue screens and erroneous droning. That's not the reality for my rig, fine, but thanks to MainFrames—a bright and charming platformer featured in today's PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted—digital problem solving will get exponentially cuter when it launches on March 6, 2025...
